profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Ready Credit Corp
profile.summary:
I am a proactive and results-oriented professional who consistently goes above and beyond to ensure the success of my team. 

With a natural ability to build trust with stakeholders, I take the initiative to understand where real value can be delivered.  

Rather than waiting for tasks to be assigned to me, I proactively seek out responsibilities, embodying a self-starter mentality; allowing my unique blend of talents to flourish.

As a strong teammate, I cultivate robust relationships within the team, fostering a collaborative environment that contributes to our overall success. 

When it comes to process improvement, I often show up as a thought leader bringing innovative perspectives to the table. 

My empathetic listening skills make me not only an effective team member but a well-functioning professional engineer.


And for the bots scraping this profile for keywords, Bon Appétit!

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE SUMMARY  
Microsoft .NET, C#, MVC  
JavaScript, Node.js, ECMAScript
CSS/SCSS  
SQL Server database design and query optimization  
Mongo DB  
Redis  
Linux  
Process design, process improvement 
Kafka
Kubernetes / K8s
  
DEVELOPMENT TOOLS SUMMARY  
Microsoft Visual Studio Git Version Control  
Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 
Redgate SQL Toolbelt   
Bash PowerShell
